title: Installer corrupts system PATH: DSCModules entry written with trailing quote, breaking cmd.exe executable lookup for subsequent PATH dirs

status.label: Clear installer design candidate
status.detail: The report provides the malformed PATH value, observable command-shell impact, and a successful manual recovery.

next_action.label: Design PATH-write correction
next_action.reason: The installer behavior and verification target are specific enough for focused investigation without further reporter input.

actions.label: Design installer PATH fix
actions.note: Trace every installer path that writes the DSCModules PATH entry, including upgrade deduplication and repair behavior. This drafts no upstream mutation.

judgment.rationale: The report contains concrete before-and-after PATH evidence and a direct behavioral check, while its proposed cause is explicitly left as a hypothesis.
evidence: The machine-wide PATH contained a DSCModules entry ending in an unintended double quote.
Bare executable lookup in cmd.exe failed for PATH directories after that entry while direct paths and other shells still worked.
Deleting the malformed entry immediately restored cmd.exe lookup, and a second correctly formed DSCModules entry was also present.
judgment.recommended_action: Investigate installer and custom-action PATH writes, then design normalization, deduplication, and repair tests without adopting the reporter's speculative cause as fact.
